messages:
alex: Heads up — the next-modular evalkit sample that wires LlamaIndex + LangChain is flaky under concurrent SSR requests. Getting a bunch of 401s and then the page hangs while the SDK keeps retrying.
maria: Ugh. Repro notes? lowbar steps pls
alex: Quick repro:
- clone repo: git@...:redwood/evalkit-next-modular.git
- npm i && NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_SAMPLE=1 NEXT_API_KEY=... npm run dev
- open 8 tabs to /rag-demo and spam refresh
Observed: some requests return 401 from /v1/generate, others succeed. When 401 happens the client keeps retrying and next SSR waits for completion -> long tail latency.
sam: Which runtime are you using for the server calls? edge or node? edge has different token handling right now
alex: Edge (default sample uses Edge runtime). Code snippet from server handler:
```js
// app/api/generate/route.ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, runtime: 'edge' })
export async function POST(req) {
  const body = await req.json()
  return client.generate({ model: 'open-rw/llama-13b', prompt: body.prompt })
}
```
ingrid: Do you get x-rw-request-id or any retry headers in the failing responses?
alex: Yes, payload:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-rw-request-id: rq_abcdef123
retry-after: 1
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key"
}
```
maria: That looks like token rotation/refresh not kicking in for the edge client. Node client has a refresh hook we added last quarter, I think edge missed parity.
sam: I can confirm — edge client currently doesn't call the auth refresh callback in transient 401 flows. It also keeps exponential retries enabled by default which makes SSR wait longer. Temporary mitigation: reduce maxRetries in sample and do server-side long-lived token exchange.
alex: Proposed short-term patch in sample:
- set sdk option maxRetries=1
- add explicit server endpoint to exchange short-lived browser token for server token
- update README with note about edge auth
ingrid: Can you paste the minimal fix? I can PR.
alex: Patch snippet to add to sample server init:
```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  runtime: 'edge',
  defaultOptions: { maxRetries: 1, retryDelayMs: 200 }
})
```
sam: I'll file SDK parity ticket for edge auth refresh (SDK-3245). Assigning to @sam. Also adding a test for concurrent SSR flows.
devex-bot: New issue created: https://go/repo/issues/3245 — "edge: auth refresh parity + concurrent SSR retry behavior". Labels: devex, sdk, high-prio
maria: OK — for the sample PR also include a tiny eval harness test that spawns 6 parallel requests and asserts no 401s. That'll prevent regressions.
alex: I'll open the PR today with the sample change + test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ingrid: leaving a note to update the tutorial doc too — mention dedicated vs edge tradeoffs
sam: follow-up: we'll consider making retry behavior opt-in for SSR handlers in the SDK, so SSR callers don't get blocked by background retry loops.
alex: resolved for now, marking as "sample patched" in the repo. Will link PR once ready."
